verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a live llms.txt at developer.monday.com (HTTP 200, titled 'monday.com Platform API Documentation'), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is also served at /.well-known/openapi.json. A documented developer MCP lets agents scaffold and manage apps from chat, adding further agent-oriented documentation surfaces. missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt content depth or coverage (e.g. an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully using these docs.
